zh.title: Boom首度運轉原型引擎核心 擬供Overture客機引擎使用
zh.summary: Boom於十一月二十一日首度運轉原型引擎核心，擬供Overture客機引擎使用
body: Boom Supersonic於十一月二十一日首次運轉原型引擎核心，展開地面測試。公司計畫將這套硬體用於Overture客機的Symphony渦輪扇引擎。據Aviation Week，測試在Boom位於丹佛以東Watkins的Colorado Air and Space Port內的設施進行。
Boom的Sprint Core原型結合壓縮機、燃燒室及高壓渦輪。創辦人兼執行長Blake Scholl在X分享運轉影片；他向Aviation Week表示，核心在第二次嘗試時點火，轉速達每分鐘6,500轉。
為建造航空引擎，Boom還須加裝風扇及低壓級，並測試完整的Symphony渦輪扇引擎。

en.title: Boom runs prototype core intended for Overture engine for first time
en.summary: Boom Supersonic first ran its prototype engine core on 21 November; the hardware is intended for Overture’s engine.
body: Boom Supersonic ran its prototype engine core for the first time on 21 November, starting ground tests of hardware it plans to use in the Symphony turbofan for its Overture airliner. According to Aviation Week, the test took place at Boom’s facility at the Colorado Air and Space Port in Watkins, east of Denver.

Boom’s Sprint Core prototype combines a compressor, a combustor and a high-pressure turbine. Founder and chief executive Blake Scholl posted footage of the run on X. He told Aviation Week that the core ignited on the second attempt and reached 6,500 revolutions per minute.
To build the aircraft engine, Boom still needs to add the fan and low-pressure stages and test the complete Symphony turbofan.

zh.title: 英國空軍司令：無人戰機預計明年在英國空域飛行
zh.summary: 英國皇家空軍司令表示，無人戰機預計明年開始在英國空域飛行。
body: 英國皇家空軍司令Harv Smyth表示，無人戰鬥機預計明年開始在英國空域飛行。
Smyth也表示，Global Combat Air Programme（GCAP）正在開發的Tempest，可能是最後一款為皇家空軍打造的有人戰鬥機。
英國正加快對協同作戰飛機（collaborative combat aircraft，CCA）的投資，其中包括BAE Systems的Brontanax展示機。
Storm Fighter計畫旨在建立自主掌握的協同作戰飛機能力。英國政府於2026年公佈的國防投資計畫，確認承諾為Storm Fighter投入3億英鎊。

en.title: RAF chief says uncrewed fighters expected to fly in UK airspace next year
en.summary: The RAF chief says uncrewed fighters are expected to begin flying in UK airspace next year.
body: Royal Air Force chief Sir Harv Smyth says uncrewed fighter aircraft are expected to begin flying in UK airspace next year.
Smyth also suggested that Tempest, the fighter being developed under the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), could be the final crewed combat aircraft built for the RAF.
The UK is accelerating investment in collaborative combat aircraft (CCAs), including BAE Systems’ Brontanax demonstrator.

The Storm Fighter programme is intended to deliver a sovereign collaborative combat aircraft capability. The UK government’s Defence Investment Plan, published in 2026, confirmed a £300 million commitment to Storm Fighter.

zh.title: 波音獲美國空軍合約 增造15架KC-46A Pegasus加油機
zh.summary: 波音獲美國空軍合約增造15架KC-46A加油機；全球簽約或服役合計203架
body: 波音於2026年11月24日表示，已獲美國空軍合約，將增造15架KC-46A Pegasus空中加油機。
波音指出，全球共有203架KC-46A多任務空中加油機已簽約或投入使用，其中116架已交付美國空軍。
自2019年首架KC-46A Pegasus交付以來，美國空軍KC-46A機隊累計飛行時數已超過18萬小時。波音表示，這反映機隊在訓練及任務飛行方面的高使用率。
波音表示，KC-46A可快速調整配置，支援包括人道援助及救災在內的多種任務。

en.title: Boeing wins U.S. Air Force contract to build 15 more KC-46A Pegasus tankers
en.summary: Boeing wins U.S. Air Force contract for 15 KC-46A Pegasus tankers; 203 are contracted or in service globally.
body: Boeing said on Nov. 24, 2026, that it had been awarded a U.S. Air Force contract to build 15 additional KC-46A Pegasus aerial refueling tankers.
The company said 203 KC-46A multi-mission aerial refuelers are on contract or in service globally. That total includes 116 delivered to the U.S. Air Force.

Since the first KC-46A Pegasus was delivered in 2019, the U.S. Air Force’s KC-46A fleet has exceeded 180,000 flight hours, according to Boeing. The company said the figure reflects high use in training and operational sorties.
Boeing said the KC-46A can be rapidly reconfigured to support missions including humanitarian assistance and disaster relief.

zh.title: FAA收緊全美Line Up and Wait規定 機場延誤恐增加
zh.summary: FAA自11月24日起收緊全美Line Up and Wait規定，機場延誤恐增加。
body: FAA自11月24日起在全美針對「Line Up and Wait」作業實施更嚴格的規定。Simple Flying在報導標題中稱FAA禁止這項作業，並將禁令形容為「永遠」。
根據Simple Flying報導，收緊「Line Up and Wait」作業規定之際，正值管制人員短缺。報導也指出，美國機場的延誤可能因這項作業限制措施而增加。

en.title: FAA Tightens Line Up and Wait Rules Nationwide; US Airport Delays May Rise
en.summary: FAA tightens Line Up and Wait rules nationwide from November 24; US airport delays may increase.
body: The FAA is introducing stricter rules for Line Up and Wait operations nationwide, with the changes taking effect from November 24, according to Simple Flying. In its headline, the publication describes the agency’s move as a ban on those operations “forever.”

The changes come at a time when controllers are in short supply, according to Simple Flying. The publication says the restrictions could lead to an increase in delays at airports in the United States.

zh.title: 報導：五角大廈與通用汽車、福特汽車初步洽談軍用無人機零件供應
zh.summary: 五角大廈據報與通用汽車、福特汽車初步洽談軍用無人機零件供應，尚未達成協議。
body: AeroTime引述《華爾街日報》報導，五角大廈正與通用汽車、福特汽車及其他製造商初步洽談，討論為軍用無人機供應零件。討論中的方案擬由汽車企業向無人機製造商供應零組件，相關談判尚未達成協議。
《華爾街日報》另報導，通用汽車正在評估是否製造無人機馬達。AeroTime指出，五角大廈官員也曾與福特及加拿大汽車零件供應商Magna International的高層會晤。
福特向路透社表示，該公司與五角大廈的討論重點是軍用車輛及衛星相關工作。
五角大廈的Drone Dominance計畫提出，到2027年需要超過20萬架航空器。

en.title: Pentagon in early talks with General Motors and Ford on military drone parts: report
en.summary: Pentagon is reportedly in early military drone-parts talks with General Motors and Ford; no agreement has been reached.
body: The Pentagon is in preliminary talks with General Motors, Ford Motor Company and other manufacturers about supplying parts for military drones, according to a Wall Street Journal report cited by AeroTime. Under the arrangement being discussed, automotive companies would supply components to drone makers; the talks have not yet produced an agreement.

The Journal reported that GM is considering whether to make drone motors. Pentagon officials have also met executives from Ford and Canadian auto-parts supplier Magna International, AeroTime reported.
Ford told Reuters that its discussions with the Pentagon focused on military vehicles and satellite work.
The Pentagon's Drone Dominance program calls for more than 200,000 aircraft by 2027.

zh.title: Virgin Atlantic擬2027年3月在曼徹斯特引進空中巴士A330neo
zh.summary: Virgin Atlantic擬2027年3月在曼徹斯特引進A330neo。
body: Virgin Atlantic計畫自2027年3月起，在曼徹斯特的航線引進空中巴士A330neo，初期用於紐約（JFK）航班。6月起，該機型也將投入奧蘭多航班。
該公司調整曼徹斯特航網，決定自明年夏季起暫停拉斯維加斯航線。根據向航空分析公司Cirium申報的時刻資料，紐約航班明年4月至6月將由每日1班增至每週10班。奧蘭多航班在假期尖峯期間將達每週最多17班。
另外，Virgin Atlantic表示，倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）的容量限制使其目前無法在該機場進一步擴張。

en.title: Virgin Atlantic plans Airbus A330neo flights from Manchester in March 2027
en.summary: Virgin Atlantic plans A330neo service from Manchester starting in March 2027.
body: Virgin Atlantic plans to introduce the Airbus A330neo at its Manchester hub from March 2027, starting on flights to New York (JFK). From June, the aircraft is also set to be deployed on flights to Orlando.

The airline has decided to suspend its Las Vegas route from Manchester starting next summer. Schedules filed with aviation analytics firm Cirium show that New York flights are due to rise from daily to 10 a week between April and June next year. Orlando flights will reach up to 17 a week during the holiday peak.
Separately, Virgin Atlantic says capacity limits at London Heathrow Airport (LHR) mean it cannot expand further there.

zh.title: Alliance Airlines執行長表示2026財年準點率達95%
zh.summary: Alliance Airlines稱2026財年準點率95%，每月約飛5千班
body: Alliance Airlines執行長Steven Greenway於2026年11月25日表示，該航空公司在2026財年每月約營運5,000班，準點率達95%。
Greenway在雪梨舉行的FACTS會議上談及飛進飛出（fly-in, fly-out，FIFO）航班；這類航班將工作人員送往西澳洲、昆士蘭州及其他偏遠地區的礦場。他呼籲外界更重視航空業在澳洲資源產業所扮演的角色。
Alliance在2026財年結束時的集團機隊共有80架飛機。該公司認為，可與資源產業更密切合作的領域包括航線開發、機隊現代化、人員流動及區域基礎設施。

en.title: Alliance Airlines CEO reports 95% on-time rate for 2026 financial year
en.summary: Alliance Airlines says its 2026 financial year on-time rate was 95%, with about 5,000 flights monthly.
body: Alliance Airlines operated about 5,000 flights a month in the 2026 financial year and recorded on-time performance of 95%, chief executive Steven Greenway said on November 25, 2026.

At the FACTS conference in Sydney, Greenway discussed fly-in, fly-out (FIFO) flights that carry workers to mines across Western Australia, Queensland and other remote regions. He called for wider recognition of aviation’s role in Australia’s resources sector.

Alliance ended the 2026 financial year with a group fleet of 80 aircraft. It sees room for closer collaboration with the resources industry on route development, fleet modernization, workforce mobility and regional infrastructure.

en.title: US Army moves to resume helicopter training flights near Washington National Airport
en.summary: The US Army is moving to resume helicopter training flights in airspace near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport as soon as the week of December 6, according to a report by Politico. Training in the corridor was halted in May 2025, months after a January 29, 2025 midair collision between an Army Black Hawk helicopter and an American Airlines regional jet killed 67 people. The Army has yet to submit a formal request for FAA approval.
body: The US Army is moving to resume helicopter training flights in airspace near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA) as soon as the week of December 6, according to a recent report by Politico. Training operations in the corridor were halted in May 2025 after an Army Black Hawk came too close to several commercial aircraft, less than two years after a January 29, 2025 midair collision between an Army Black Hawk helicopter and an American Airlines regional jet killed 67 people. The Army has yet to submit a formal request for approval from the Federal Aviation Administration, and the move faces pushback from labor unions and some members of Congress.

Existing FAA regulations explicitly exclude routine training from the essential flight categories in the designated Potomac zone, so without authorization the Army cannot legally operate its helicopters for training there. Proficiency evaluations, routine training and non-essential personnel transport are prohibited in the zone, and resuming routine flights would require either a formal regulatory modification or an approved authorization process. Investigations by the National Transportation Safety Board and the Army traced the January 2025 collision to tight vertical margins near low-altitude river routes, radio frequency congestion, altimeter instrument errors and pilot night-vision goggle limitations; the board issued 50 safety recommendations, including eight directed at the Army, and concluded that an ADS-B Out system could have helped air traffic controllers see the helicopter. The Army has since added ADS-B Out to its UH-60 Black Hawk fleet and replaced two altimeter models after issues were identified with the old models.

The Association of Flight Attendants-CWA and the Air Line Pilots Association oppose resuming the training flights, and AFA President Sara Nelson condemned the plans. Lawmakers remain divided over final statutory mandates for shared airspace and traffic-alerting equipment: the Rotor Operations Transparency and Oversight Reform Act passed the Senate unanimously in December 2025 but stalled in the House, although leaders announced an agreement in principle in mid-November 2026.

zh.title: 美軍擬12月初恢復華盛頓國家機場附近直升機訓練飛行
zh.summary: 美國陸軍計劃最快12月6日當週恢復華盛頓國家機場附近空域的直升機訓練飛行；相關訓練自2025年5月暫停，原因是同年1月29日陸軍黑鷹直升機與美國航空地區客機相撞造成67人罹難。恢復訓練仍需美國聯邦航空總署批准，陸軍尚未正式提出申請。
body: 據Politico報導，美國陸軍計劃最快12月6日當週恢復華盛頓國家機場附近空域的直升機訓練飛行。相關訓練自2025年5月暫停，當時一架陸軍黑鷹直升機過於接近數架民航機；此舉距2025年1月29日陸軍黑鷹直升機與美國航空地區客機相撞造成67人罹難還不到兩年。陸軍尚未向美國聯邦航空總署正式提出申請，恢復計畫也面臨工會與部分國會議員的反對。

根據現行規定，例行訓練不在波多馬克指定空域的必要飛行類別之列，未經授權陸軍不得在該空域進行訓練飛行；熟練度評估、例行訓練與非必要人員運輸均被禁止，須透過法規修改或核准授權程序才能恢復。美國國家運輸安全委員會與陸軍的調查指出，2025年1月相撞事故與低空河道航線垂直間隔過小、無線電頻率壅塞、高度表誤差及飛行員夜視鏡限制等多項因素有關；委員會提出50項安全建議，其中8項針對陸軍，並認為ADS-B Out系統有助航管看見直升機。陸軍已為UH-60黑鷹機隊加裝ADS-B Out，並更換兩款有問題的高度表。
勞工方面，美國空服員協會與航空公司飛行員協會均反對恢復訓練，空服員協會主席Sara Nelson予以譴責；國會方面，《旋翼機運作透明與監督改革法》2025年12月在參議院一致通過，但在眾議院停滯，領袖已於2026年11月中旬宣布原則上達成協議。

zh.title: NASA接收洛克希德馬丁移交的X-59超音速研究機
zh.summary: NASA表示已接收洛克希德馬丁於11月18日移交的X-59研究機，飛行測試持續。
body: 美國太空總署（NASA）表示，洛克希德馬丁的臭鼬工廠（Skunk Works）於11月18日正式將X-59超音速研究機移交給NASA。該機目前由NASA持有，持續進行飛行測試；洛克希德馬丁將視需要提供補充支援。
X-59的設計目標是在超音速飛行時，將響亮音爆減弱為較輕的「音爆悶響」。
X-59於2025年10月28日首飛，並在2026年6月5日首次飛越音速。該次飛行從愛德華空軍基地起飛，速度達約1.1馬赫。
NASA表示，當時伴飛的F-15所產生的音爆掩蓋了X-59發出的任何聲響。

en.title: NASA takes ownership of X-59 supersonic research aircraft from Lockheed Martin
en.summary: NASA says it received the X-59 research aircraft from Lockheed Martin on November 18; flight testing continues.
body: NASA says Lockheed Martin Skunk Works officially transferred the X-59 supersonic research aircraft to the agency on November 18. The aircraft continues flight testing under NASA ownership, with Lockheed Martin to provide supplemental support as needed.
The X-59 is designed to fly faster than sound while reducing a loud sonic boom to a quieter “sonic thump.”
The aircraft first flew on October 28, 2025. On June 5, 2026, it flew faster than sound for the first time, reaching about Mach 1.1 after taking off from Edwards Air Force Base.
NASA said sonic booms from an accompanying F-15 obscured any sound made by the X-59 during the flight.

zh.title: 馬來西亞航空集團承諾採購 10 架波音 787-10，另有 6 架選擇權
zh.summary: 馬來西亞航空集團選定波音 787-10 更新長程機隊，規劃從 2032 年起逐步替換現有的七架空中巴士 A350。
body: 馬來西亞航空集團與波音 11 月 25 日公布採購計畫，集團承諾採購 10 架 787-10，並取得另外 6 架的選擇權。波音表示，採購仍待最終確認。
馬來西亞航空集團計畫在 2032 年至 2035 年間逐步替換現有的七架空中巴士 A350，以更新馬來西亞航空的長程機隊。

en.title: Malaysia Aviation Group commits to 10 Boeing 787-10s with options for six more
en.summary: Malaysia Aviation Group has selected the 787 for its long-haul fleet renewal and plans to begin replacing its seven Airbus A350s in 2032.
body: Malaysia Aviation Group and Boeing announced a commitment for 10 Boeing 787-10 Dreamliners on November 25, with options for six more. Boeing said the purchase is subject to finalization.
Malaysia Aviation Group plans to phase out its seven Airbus A350s between 2032 and 2035 as it renews Malaysia Airlines’ long-haul fleet.

facts.claim: The commitment covers ten Boeing 787-10s and six additional aircraft options. Boeing says the purchase is subject to finalization.
The new jets are intended to replace seven A350s in phases from 2032 to 2035.

zh.title: 美國航空與 Israir 簽合作協議，規劃 2027 年恢復紐約至特拉維夫航班
zh.summary: 美國航空計畫於 2027 年 3 月 27 日恢復紐約甘迺迪機場至特拉維夫的每日直飛，Israir 預計在這條航線實施共用班號。
body: 美國航空與以色列航空公司 Israir 簽署商業合作協議，將分階段擴大美國與以色列之間的銜接選項。美國航空計畫自 2027 年 3 月 27 日起，以波音 777-200ER 執飛紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）至特拉維夫（TLV）的每日航班。
第一階段，Israir 預計在美國航空的紐約至特拉維夫航班掛上自家班號。雙方也將研擬聯運安排，讓 Israir 旅客在 JFK 轉接美國航空飛往美國各地、加拿大、拉丁美洲和加勒比海的航班。

en.title: American and Israir sign partnership ahead of planned JFK–Tel Aviv resumption
en.summary: American Airlines plans to resume daily JFK–Tel Aviv flights on March 27, 2027. Israir expects to add its code to the nonstop service.
body: American Airlines and Israeli carrier Israir have signed a commercial agreement to improve connections between Israel and the United States in phases. American plans to resume daily Boeing 777-200ER service between New York JFK and Tel Aviv on March 27, 2027.

Initially, Israir expects to add its code to American’s JFK–Tel Aviv flights. The airlines will also work on an interline agreement for Israir customers connecting at JFK to American flights within the United States and to Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean.

facts.claim: American plans to resume daily JFK–Tel Aviv flights on March 27, 2027, on Boeing 777-200ER aircraft.
Israir expects to codeshare on American’s nonstop service, and the carriers intend to implement an interline agreement for onward travel from JFK.
